blocking_findings.requirement: R25 and docs/development-workflow.md Action commit-SHA pinning
blocking_findings.title: pnpm/action-setup reference is an annotated-tag object rather than a commit
blocking_findings.failure_case: The workflow references f40ffcd9367d9f12939873eb1018b921a783ffaa. Independent git ls-remote verification resolves that as refs/tags/v4 and b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 as its peeled commit, so the normative workflow does not satisfy the explicit commit-SHA rule.
blocking_findings.resolution: Replace the reference with the verified peeled commit SHA and obtain fresh reviews on the updated scope hash before bootstrap.

nonblocking_notes.requirement: R03 and R25 required Linux desktop smoke
nonblocking_notes.title: Configure the CI sandbox prerequisite without disabling sandboxing
nonblocking_notes.failure_case: Xvfb does not supply Chromium sandbox prerequisites, and Ubuntu user-namespace policy may differ from the local machine where smoke passed.
nonblocking_notes.resolution: On the disposable GitHub-hosted Linux VM, install the pinned Electron binary, resolve and verify its bundled chrome-sandbox, set only that helper root-owned mode 4755, and run Electron as the ordinary runner user. Do not disable sandboxing or change global AppArmor/sysctl policy; qualify installed packages separately.
